corrupt.title: Integrity Check Failed
corrupt.detail: The downloaded model file is truncated or corrupted (likely due to background network interruption).
corrupt.recommendation: Re-download the model file cleanly or switch to a cached model in Settings.

missing.title: Model Asset Missing
missing.detail: The designated GGUF model binary is not present in local device storage.
missing.recommendation: Relaunch the Setup Wizard or select an installed model from the catalog.

memory.title: Hardware RAM Exceeded
memory.detail: Insufficient resident memory to mmap the GGUF model weights and initialize KV cache.
memory.recommendation: Close background apps or switch to a lighter model (e.g., Compact 1.2GB) in Settings.

general.title: Engine Initialization Halted
general.detailFallback: Llama.rn engine failed to bind to the local GGUF context.
general.recommendation: Review model settings or re-run the Setup Wizard to restore defaults.

chatScreen.reasoningUnfinished: Reasoning didn't finish before the reply ended (stopped or out of tokens). Tap 💭 to read it.
chatScreen.stageTimedOut: A research step took too long and was cut short
chatScreen.interruptedByBackground: Paused — app was backgrounded. Ask again to continue.

succinct.label: Succinct & Direct
succinct.description: Fastest — 2–3 brief paragraphs or bullets, no preamble. Default for mobile.

detailed.label: Thorough & Detailed
detailed.description: Structured, thorough explanations with comparisons and reasoning.

summary.label: Executive Summary
summary.description: One top-line takeaway, then 3 key bullet points.

evaluation.title: EVALUATION
evaluation.subtitle: Set v{{version}} · {{count}} queries
evaluation.keepScreenOn: Keep the screen on and the app open while it runs. Each answer is also printed to the Metro terminal as an [EVAL] line.
evaluation.chatBusy: Wait for the current chat reply to finish before running an evaluation.

nav.subtitle: Offline research
nav.noHistory: Your conversations stay on this device and show up here.
nav.deleteChatBody: "{{title}}" will be removed from this device. This can't be undone.

usageStats.lastQueryEmpty: Ask a question to see measurements here.
usageStats.routingFailed: Adaptive routing failed for the last message, so the selected model answered instead.

answerMode.quickModel: Shows a passage from your sources right away. If it answers the question, it stops there; otherwise your chosen model answers. You can ask for a full answer.
answerMode.quickComplete: Shows a passage from your sources as a preview, then writes a full answer: it splits the question, researches each part and checks the result. Slower.
answerMode.directComplete: Always writes a full answer: it splits the question, researches each part and checks the result. Slower.
answerMode.directModel: Your chosen model always answers. Ask for a full answer when you need one.

settings.voiceNote: Uses your phone's speech recognition. On some phones it sends audio to an online service, so it is off by default.
settings.eraseKnowledge: Knowledge packs and your document collections
settings.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change. Try again.

tone.footer: Changes how answers are written, starting with the next question.
tone.customHelper: Tell the model how to answer, for example: "Answer in bullet points."

length.footer: The model stops after this many tokens. A token is about three quarters of a word.

history.autoTitlesHint: Uses the first question as the title.
history.autoSummarizeHint: Keeps answers fast by summarizing older messages.
history.keepFooter: Older conversations are deleted when you go over the limit.
history.clearBody: Every conversation on this phone will be deleted. This can't be undone.

fit.thrashing: May be slow on this phone: it needs most of its memory.

error.storage: Not enough free space on the phone.
error.hash-mismatch: The file doesn't match the expected one. Download it again.

performance.typicalFooter: Medians. A token is about three quarters of a word.
performance.fitsFooter: Limits of the offline AI challenge this build targets: {{ram}} of memory and {{storage}} of storage.
performance.evaluationSub: Runs a fixed set of questions on installed models.

about.how1: BOAR answers with a language model that runs on this phone, using llama.cpp. After setup it needs no internet.
about.how2: Before answering, it searches the knowledge stored on the phone (Wikipedia collections and your documents) and cites the passages it used.
about.how3: Every answer is measured on the phone. See Performance for speed and memory.
about.installedFooter: Each model and collection keeps its own license.
about.sourceFooter: Code, model list and build scripts are public.

onboarding.tagline: AI research that runs entirely on your phone, without internet.
onboarding.point1: Works offline once it is set up.
onboarding.point2: Your questions never leave the phone.
onboarding.point3: Shows the sources behind each answer.
onboarding.step2Sub: Everything is downloaded once and then works offline.
onboarding.step3Sub: This is the only time BOAR uses the internet.

essential.name: Essential
essential.body: Answer and search models, plus the core Wikipedia topic collections.

encyclopedia.name: Encyclopedia
encyclopedia.body: Essential plus the Wikipedia Vital Articles pack, for broader questions.

onboarding.backBody: Downloads already running keep going while BOAR is open.
onboarding.keepOpen: Keep BOAR open until it finishes. If you leave, the download may pause; it continues where it stopped when you come back.
onboarding.doneBody: Everything runs offline from now on.
